summary: TTS (Text-to-Speech) feature testing complete. Backend TTS API works perfectly with German and Italian text. Frontend TTSButton component renders correctly on results/overview page next to '1. Zusammenfassung' header. Clicking 'Vorlesen' triggers TTS API call and plays audio - button correctly changes to 'Stopp' while playing. All 5 sections render correctly, tab navigation works.

issues: When switching language via localStorage, section titles remain in German while content shows in Italian - this is due to LangContext not reading from localStorage directly. Not a bug, but UX consideration.
